fields.flags: Feature flags (Bit 0: Linked Extents, Bit 1: Dynamic Inode Chunks)
fields.inode_bitmap_start: Starting block of primary inode allocation bitmap
fields.block_bitmap_start: Starting block of data block bitmap
fields.inode_table_start: Starting block of primary Inode Table
fields.data_blocks_start: Starting block of data blocks pool
fields.primary_inodes: Count of static primary inodes allocated at format time
fields.dynamic_chunk_tree: LBA of root chunk-tree block for auto-expanding inode tables
fields.dynamic_chunks_count: Number of active dynamically appended inode chunks
fields.dynamic_inodes_count: Total capacity of dynamically allocated inodes
fields.dynamic_inodes_used: Number of in-use dynamic inodes across appended chunks

ipo_inode.title: IPO_FS Inode Structure (128 bytes, 4 per block)

fields.extents: 4 primary contiguous extent descriptors (24 B each)
fields.next_extent_node: Physical block of chained extent node (0 if none)

fields.physical_block: Starting physical LBA block in storage pool

storage_pool_raw_sb.title: Storage Pool Superblock (storage_pool_raw_sb_t, LBA 2030 & 2039)
storage_pool_raw_sb.totalSize: 512 bytes (68 B header + flexible members[] + CRC32)

fields.local_member_uuid: 128-bit UUID of the local drive member
fields.member_index: Index of this drive in the spanned pool
fields.member_count: Total number of drives in the storage pool
fields.total_capacity_sectors: Combined capacity across all member drives in sectors
fields.members: Flexible on-disk array of member descriptors (48 B each)

storage_raw_disk_tx_entry.title: Storage Pool WAL Journal Entry (storage_raw_disk_tx_entry_t, LBA 2031–2038)
storage_raw_disk_tx_entry.totalSize: 64 bytes (8 entries per 512-byte sector, 64 entries total)

fields.lba: Target logical block address in storage pool
fields.count: Number of sectors affected by transaction
fields.data_crc: CRC32 checksum of the written sector payload
fields.entry_crc: CRC32 checksum of the journal entry header

kmod_header.title: Relocatable Kernel Module Descriptor (kmod_t / .kmd PIC binary)

fields.id: Unique monotonic module ID assigned on registration
fields.name: Dynamic module name string (strdup)
fields.author: Dynamic author metadata string (strdup)
fields.image_base: Kernel virtual base address of mapped/relocated .kmd image
fields.next: Next loaded module pointer in linked module list
fields.resolve_sym_metadata: Optional kernel dynamic symbol resolver metadata hook

fields.cpu_id: Logical processor core ID (0 = BSP, 1..N = AP)
fields.is_online: Set to true once AP finishes 16->32->64-bit trampoline boot
fields.stack_base: Dynamically allocated 16 KiB per-CPU kernel stack base
fields.stack_top: Initial 64-bit stack top passed to AP trampoline
fields.tasks_executed: Total completed SMP work/scheduler tasks on this core
fields.tasks_queued: Pending tasks currently queued on this core
fields.busy: True while core is actively executing a parallel SMP task
fields.current_task_id: Identifier of active SMP worker task (0 if idle)

process_pcb.title: Process Descriptor Structure (process_t, src/include/kernel/process.h)
process_pcb.totalSize: Dynamically linked PCB with unbounded dynamic arrays/heaps

fields.binary_base / entry_point: 64-bit process base address and loaded entrypoint (ELF64/ELF32/flat)
fields.arch_ctx: Full 64-bit/32-bit x86 register context (RAX..R15, RIP, RSP, RFLAGS, CR3)
fields.address_space: Per-process PML4/LA57 or PD page-table pointer for strict isolation
fields.stack_base / stack_size: Guard-paged thread stack growing dynamically on #PF from 4096 B
fields.return_val: Full typed return value (scalar, 64-bit pair, dynamic string, or struct buffer)
fields.user_heap_base / heap_chunks: Isolated sbrk() heap base (0x10000000+ or 0x09000000) & dynamic chunk table
fields.mmap_regions: Dynamic array of per-process ipo_mmap() and SHM (0xD0000000+) mappings
fields.threads / thread_count: Dynamic array of kernel-scheduled POSIX thread descriptors (TIDs, TLS)
fields.signal_handlers / pending: Per-process POSIX sigaction table, blocked masks, and pending signal queue
fields.text_vram_backup / text_output_buf: Dynamic workspace terminal cell buffer backup and expanding stdout capture buffer
fields.name / return_format / next: Dynamic process name, DWARF return format string, and linked-list pointer

device_node.title: Unified Hardware Device Node (device_node_t)
device_node.totalSize: Dynamically sized with self-expanding 64-bit BAR array (src/include/kernel/device.h)

fields.parent_id: Parent bus/controller device ID (0 if root)
fields.capabilities: Capability bitmask (READONLY, REMOVABLE, HOTPLUGGABLE, DMA, VIRTUAL)
fields.type: Category (CPU, MEMORY, PCI, STORAGE, NETWORK, INPUT, AUDIO, VIDEO, SYSTEM, USB)
fields.state: Operational state (DISCOVERED, DRIVER_ATTACHED, INITIALIZED, ACTIVE, DISABLED, ERROR)
fields.name: Dynamic canonical identifier (e.g. "cpu0", "pci00:03.0", "ata0")
fields.vendor / model / description: Dynamically allocated vendor, model, and functional description strings
fields.res: Bus coordinates, PCI IDs, dynamic uint64_t* bar[], 64-bit I/O & MMIO bases, IRQ, size
fields.driver_name / driver_ptr: Attached driver name and pointer to driver_t
fields.ops / priv_data / next: Unified device I/O ops (64-bit offset open/close/read/write/ioctl) and list link

kmalloc_stats.title: Kernel Heap Allocator Statistics (kmalloc_stats_t)
kmalloc_stats.totalSize: 28 bytes (Primary arena at 64 MiB 0x04000000 + PMM overflow arenas)

fields.heap_total: Total active kernel heap capacity across primary + overflow arenas
fields.heap_used: Bytes consumed by allocated blocks and arena headers
fields.free_bytes: Bytes available in coalesced free blocks

fields.irq: Hardware IRQ line (14 for Primary, 15 for Secondary)
fields.model: Dynamically allocated NUL-terminated ATA model string
fields.serial: Dynamically allocated NUL-terminated ATA serial string
fields.firmware: Dynamically allocated NUL-terminated ATA firmware revision string

fields.base_lo: Lower 16 bits of ISR entrypoint address
fields.base_hi: Upper 16/48 bits of ISR entrypoint address

fields.POST_ROMSTAGE_START: 0x15 — Protected-mode XIP C romstage entered from bootblock
fields.POST_ROMSTAGE_OK: 0x16 — Chipset probe, SPD/MRC DRAM setup, and PAM shadow copy complete
fields.POST_WARN_SPD_FAIL: 0x1F — SMBus SPD/timing non-fatal warning; fallback timings active
fields.POST_NOMTRR_BYPASS: 0x2E — MTRRs unsupported on emulator/host; .car_bypass fallback active

fields.POST_DISK_SPINUP_WAIT: 0x29 — Firmware waiting for IDE/AHCI/NVMe storage spinup and ready status
